## [0.5.3](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/compare/v0.5.2...v0.5.3) (2026-09-30)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* push a zero before the forced steps, not just the steps ([f51ed17](https://github.com/dunecache/oyasumi-patches/commit/f51ed1783a74db8ddf6b33b5113aeff89d6e169d))

patches.name: Force Walk & Win steps to 10000
patches.description: Report 10,000 steps to Djezzy's Walk & Win campaign, both on every step-counter event and once when the step stream is first subscribed. The subscribe push is a zero followed by 10,000, because one value cannot both open the counter's accumulation window and jump through it.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Skip ADM's Appodeal and AppBrain ad setup and display routines, and the Telegram join prompt.

patches.name: Disable rating prompts
patches.description: Skip ADM's automatic rating prompt. The menu item that opens the same dialog on request is left intact.

patches.name: Increase connection limits
patches.description: Raise the download ceilings to 32 simultaneous downloads and 64 connections per download, and set torrent defaults to 500 global and 100 per torrent.

patches.name: Disable home screen ads
patches.description: Keep 1DM's home screen banner from loading, rotating, or rendering, including the built-in "install 1DM+" banner ad.
